title: TCS Sydney Marathon 2026 Pace Team
claims: The 2026 Pace Team page lists target finish times from 2:30 to 7:00 and a sweep group covering up to 7 hours.
Each pacer carries a flag displaying the target finish time.
Pacers are assigned to the red, green and orange start waves at St Leonards Park, and runners align by bib colour and chute.
The 2026 Pace Team applications have closed and 2027 applications open in January 2027.
The page presents the pace groups as an aid to runners, not as an official pace requirement.
